tool_args.rationale: The broad sink-gradient span and the acquired open-branch point support fitting the two-layer siphon base while selecting among the documented square-root and linear-leak branch variants by residual. The model numerically fits parameters using all paid rows and does not require further measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired at cost 2; it added a broad-input, low-gradient point that helps resolve branch behavior.
All rows use the same short horizon and zero memory input; no trajectory evidence suggests a coupled-memory mechanism.
It is not informative for the target law and is explicitly unnecessary.

considered_alternatives.option: Static quadratic or single-factor Michaelis law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures and systematic dependence on sink gradient favor the two-layer inhibited saturating-input form.
